com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-processor 00.74.10 发布, Compile-time annotation processor that generates a Secured wrapper
    subclass for each @Secured-annotated concrete class. The generated
    wrapper routes every public, non-final, non-static method through
    JSentinelEnforcer when the method (or class) carries a method-security
    annotation (@RequiresRole, @RequiresPermission, @RequiresAnyPermission,
    @RequiresAllPermissions, @RequiresPolicy).

    Runtime sibling: SecuredProxy in jSentinel-standalone for the
    JDK-dynamic-proxy path on interfaces.

com.svenruppert.jsentinel:jSentinel-credentials-hibp 00.74.10 发布, Optional Phase-5 extension that adds a HaveIBeenPwned-style online
    compromised-password checker on top of the V00.71 SPI from
    jSentinel-core. The checker uses the k-anonymity range API: only
    the first five hex chars of the candidate's SHA-1 digest leave the
    process, never the plaintext password (CWE-359). The implementation
    relies on JDK HttpClient only — no additional runtime dependencies.
    Strictly opt-in; applications that do not depend on this module
    perform no online lookups.
